name: /monthly-review
description: Monthly directional review: vision alignment, trends, course correction

steps.context: Read .exocortex/TODO.md, recent events, .exocortex/control/INTERRUPTS.md, .exocortex/OPEN_DECISIONS.md, and .exocortex/control/ROADMAP.md. Reflect: what built/learned, what aligned with vision, what felt wasteful. Review trends: repeated interrupt themes, repeated blockers, energy vs output mismatch. Ask 3 directional questions: 1) What should you stop doing? 2) What deserves more focus? 3) Is the direction still correct?

Propose updates to PROJECT_MEMORY.md (only if direction changed), SESSION_CONTEXT.md, and high-level TODO priorities. About direction, not productivity. Fewer priorities is better. Ask 'Approve these directional updates?' Only write after explicit approval.

steps.action: Write monthly review summary event and sync to RAG API
